episodes.synopsis: Lorna goes on an adventure with her skill, the Internet, which grants her access to near infinite knowledge.
episodes.title: I Tried Using the Internet!

episodes.synopsis: Lorna arrives in Aiphoné and goes to register with the adventurer's guild.
episodes.title: I Tried Becoming an Adventurer!

episodes.synopsis: Lorna must overcome a dungeon considered impossible to complete if she wants to pass the exam.
episodes.title: I Tried Looking At Message Boards!

episodes.synopsis: Lorna unexpectedly saves an elf and is taken to the hidden elven village plagued by a strange disease.
episodes.title: I Tried Stopping Someone's Ambition!

episodes.synopsis: While the elves celebrate the end of the plague, Lorna feels guilty about being revered as their Savior.
episodes.title: I Tried Quitting Being a Savior!

episodes.synopsis: Lorna visits the port town of Aquas and discovers why the townsfolk are terrified of Wednesdays.
episodes.title: I Tried Becoming a God!
